description: P5b (D-146): authored source rows for the 57-good catalogue of the 1900 world. 1900 US prices (converted to RUSD by the builder with the P2b CPI rows), 1900 output by country or territory (shares only, D-146 A5), and the evidence for the technologies countries know in 1900 (D-146 A9). Every value was read from the page image of the cited volume; locators give the book page and, for scanned PDFs, the PDF page. Status: sourced = read from the cited table; estimated = the source itself marks the value as an estimate; provisional = a project assumption with its reasoning.

crops1900.description: D-146 A12: 1900 figures for coffee, tea, cocoa, tobacco and rubber by producer, kg. Production where the source gives it, otherwise exports or market receipts (marked; status 'estimated' where exports of another year, half a year or a mean of two estimates stand for 1900). When a territory has both a production and an export row for a crop, placement uses the production row. worldEstimates give each crop's world figure for the coverage rule; selfSupplied lists producers that the sources name but do not record. Batch 1 is the first set of 2026-11-08; batches 2 and 3 close the A12 gaps. A row with `transferFrom` moves its kg out of that territory's row of the same crop (rubber shipped through Para). Placement rule: scripts/p5b/placement.mjs (D-148 additions, item 9).

coverage.rubber: Recorded: Brazil (Para receipts, less Bolivia's rubber; Peru's caucho and Iquitos rubber stay inside), the Gold Coast (batch 1); the Congo via Antwerp and Lagos (batch 2); Angola, the Ivory Coast and Bolivia (batch 3). Missing: Centrals (Central America, Mexico, Colombia, Ecuador, Peruvian caucho), Kamerun, Gabon, East Africa, Madagascar, the East Indies.
